Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and docs having a pubmed_id. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
